The '''Emerald Ocean''' was located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. A [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] service that operated out of the Chandrilan [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Emita/Legends|Emita]] crossed the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] to reach [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], Chandrila's [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Emerald Ocean was introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' expansion ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of its [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
